Class ModelMyLessons

java.lang.Object
guiMyLessons.ModelMyLessons
public class ModelMyLessons extends Object

Title: ModelMyLessons Class.

Description: The My Lessons Page Model. This class holds the data the page displays: the full list of lessons the logged-in contributor is allowed to see, and the search text the contributor has entered. The View shows whatever subset this Model provides, and the Controller changes the Model when the contributor searches or the data changes.

  • Method Details

    • loadLessons

      protected static void loadLessons(database.Database database, String username)

      Method: loadLessons(Database database, String username)

      Description: Reads the contributor's lessons from the database. Only lessons this contributor added are loaded, including any a curator has since edited, so another contributor's lessons can never appear on this page.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      username - is the logged-in contributor's username

    • getVisibleLessons

      protected static entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList getVisibleLessons()

      Method: LessonsLearnedList getVisibleLessons()

      Description: Returns the lessons the page should show right now: the contributor's lessons that match the search text, or all of them when the search is blank.

      Returns:
      the subset to display (may be empty, never null)

    • getTotalLessons

      protected static int getTotalLessons()

      Method: int getTotalLessons()

      Description: Returns how many lessons the contributor has in total, before any search, so the page can tell "you have no lessons" apart from "no lessons match your search".

      Returns:
      the number of lessons this contributor has

    • setSearchText

      protected static void setSearchText(String text)

      Method: setSearchText(String text)

      Description: Records the keywords to search for. Null is stored as "" so the Model never has to check for it.

      Parameters:
      text - the keywords entered by the contributor

    • getSearchText

      protected static String getSearchText()

      Method: String getSearchText()

      Description: Returns the keywords currently being searched for.

      Returns:
      the search text ("" when there is no search)
